record.question: Dysmenorrhea is caused by:
record.explanation: Primary dysmenorrhoea is attributed to excess prostaglandin release by the secretory endometrium during the luteal phase, which drives uterine contractions and ischaemic pain. Of the listed options, the secretory endometrium is the mechanistic source, so it is chosen with medium confidence.
